Area note · #33401 · follow-up named (review-c N2 on PR #33995, 6897171983)

The CONTROL this card's acceptance names (a same-name package-less action on another object) is unreachable today because of an envelope defect in `protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` `readMetaItem`: the action is stamped with the disabled holder's `_packageId`, so the by-name read answers 404. That is the same on main. The seat folded the defect into **#33904** as acceptance item 2. Its dev is re-measuring on main after PR #33898, which may already fix it. Either a disabled-holder pin closes it there, or #33904 carries the fix. The CONTROL is tracked there, not here.
